title: Appending a unary state symbol
statement: For every natural number $n$, updating the unary state tape encoding $n$ at cell $n+1$ to contain $1$ gives the unary state tape encoding $n+1$.
replaced:
Writing the symbol $1$ into cell $n+1$ of the unary state tape representing
$n$ (a marker $0$ in cell $0$ followed by $n$ ones) yields the unary state
tape representing $n+1$.
